title: Pointwise partition-of-unity decomposition of div_M Y + ⟨Y, H⟩ on M
statement:
Let N, p ∈ ℕ, M, S, O ⊆ ℝᴺ, Y : ℝᴺ → ℝᴺ of class C¹, and ζ_q : ℝᴺ → ℝ of class C¹ for q ∈ Fin p. Assume:
- S is closed and Y(x) = 0 for x ∉ S;
- O is open, M ∩ S ⊆ O, and Σ_q ζ_q(z) = 1 for every z ∈ O.
Then for every y ∈ M:
tangentialDivergence M Y y + ⟨Y(y), meanCurvature M y⟩ = Σ_q (tangentialDivergence M (ζ_q Y) y + ⟨ζ_q(y) Y(y), meanCurvature M y⟩),
where ζ_q Y denotes the field z ↦ ζ_q(z) Y(z).
lean_statement: ∀ (N p : ℕ) (M S O : Set (Rn N)) (Y : Rn N → Rn N) (ζ : Fin p → Rn N → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 Y → (∀ q, ContDiff ℝ 1 (ζ q)) → IsClosed S → (∀ x ∉ S, Y x = 0) → IsOpen O → M ∩ S ⊆ O → (∀ z ∈ O, ∑ q, ζ q z = 1) → ∀ y ∈ M, tangentialDivergence M Y y + inner ℝ (Y y) (meanCurvature M y) = ∑ q, (tangentialDivergence M (fun z ↦ ζ q z • Y z) y + inner ℝ (ζ q y • Y y) (meanCurvature M y))
